title: File:Tavar Zawacki Mural METAMORPHOSIS Buffalo 2019.jpg
author: Hdepot
description: Photograph of Tavar Zawacki’s large-scale mural Metamorphosis #5, completed in September 2019 in Buffalo, New York. Commissioned by the Albright–Knox Art Gallery as part of its Public Art Initiative, the work spans the full façade of a multi-story building and is the largest mural of Zawacki’s career. The composition features interlocking and overlapping arrow forms in a vivid, high-contrast palet
